findings.evidence: Lines 117–141 of the new file: `have hbound (a : BoundedFlow lo hi s t) (S : Finset V)` and `have hcut (S : Finset V)` with four `by_cases` branches. Branches 2 and 3 are mirror copies built from `ite_eq_right`/`ite_eq_left`.
findings.fix: Move `hbound` into `Flow.lean` as a named `BoundedFlow` lemma next to `val_le_cutBound` and `neg_cutBound_compl_le_val`. Move `hcut` into its own lemma taking `f.val ≤ q ≤ g.val`. Then the main theorem only calls `ExcessFlow.exists_mem_of_forall_cut` and builds the assignment.
findings.issue: `exists_val_eq_mem` (~45 uncommented lines) builds two reusable facts inline: `hbound` (a cut inequality for any bounded assignment and any `S`, by which terminals `S` contains) and `hcut` (the Hoffman cut condition for demand `Pi.single t q - Pi.single s q`). Cases 2 and 3 of `hcut` repeat the same `simp only [ite_eq_…]`/`calc` pattern.

findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/Combinatorics/Network/Flow.lean:173: theorem val_swap (f : BoundedFlow lo hi s t) : f.swap.val = -f.val`
findings.fix: Use the existing lemma directly: `rw [← neg_neg m.val, ← val_swap, hmval]` here, and `rw [← neg_neg f.val, ← val_swap, hT]` (or `neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.1`) at line 95.
findings.issue: `range_val_eq_Icc_pairMinimumValue` ends with a nested `simpa using congrArg (fun q ↦ Set.Icc q …) (by simpa using congrArg Neg.neg hmval)`. This relies on simp normalizing `val_swap` and `neg_neg` inside a lambda congruence, which is hard to read and fragile. `IsMinimum.exists_val_eq_neg_cutBound_compl` (line 95) uses the same trick: `simpa using congrArg Neg.neg hT`.

summary: Two fixable proof-quality issues. `exists_val_eq_mem` keeps a reusable cut inequality and duplicated case reasoning inline, and two endpoint proofs go through `congrArg Neg.neg` plus `simpa` where a direct `val_swap` rewrite is available.
